signals.title: CHF/JPY — G10 Bilateral Theme + JPY Momentum Outperformance
signals.text: JPY's 1W average performance of +1.252% (n=7) against CHF's -0.735% (n=6) creates a 1.987% G10 leader-laggard spread, driving CHF/JPY downside into the open. The JPY strength is reinforced by a positive ESI of +16.1 and a significant USD/JPY put skew (RR -2.20), while CHF remains the G10 laggard despite its mildly accommodative real rate of -0.45%. The next BoJ meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) is the catalyst for confirming whether this JPY momentum can overcome the 266bp US-JPY OIS carry disadvantage.

signals.title: USD/CAD — NFP Shock + Bull Steepener Regime
signals.text: The USD/CAD Friday close of 1.3936 faces downside pressure toward the SMA200 (1.3852) after a negative US payrolls shock (-23K) triggered a bull steepener regime (+48bp 2s10s spread). Crowded CAD shorts (lev_net -102.3k) face significant squeeze risk as US Treasury yields collapse and the US ESI falls to -6.7. The next BoC meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 9 Sep determines if the +133bp OIS carry advantage for USD can hold against this positioning unwind.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Crowded Long Positioning Risk
signals.text: AUD COT LF net long +37,990 (72% long) creates a crowded-long unwind risk despite the Friday close at 0.7071 above all major SMAs. RBA holds at 4.35%. The next RBA meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 11 Aug is the catalyst for resolving this positioning tension.

signals.title: USD/NOK — Retail Sentiment Extreme + ESI Divergence
signals.text: USD/NOK 100% retail long positioning signals an extreme contrarian reversal risk toward the Friday close of 9.497. The Norges Bank (4.25%) maintains a restrictive real rate of +1.51%, creating a hawkish divergence against the Fed's easing bias following the NFP miss. The next NOK meeting on 13 Aug is the catalyst for determining if the pair can sustain its position below the SMA200 (9.706).

signals.title: EUR/USD — ECB Hike Bias vs Negative COT Skew
signals.text: EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1562 with an ECB hike bias providing support, yet the lev_net short -73,049 (66% short) indicates a massive specimen short-squeeze setup is active. The +146bp OIS carry advantage for USD is narrowing as US inflation expectations (2.19%) are tested by the recent payrolls miss. The next ECB meeting (mkt: 53% hike priced) on 10 Sep determines if the positive EUR ESI (+7.2) can force an unwind of these speculative shorts.
